Epoch.description: Geologic epoch classification of each sediment sample (Pleistocene or Pliocene).

Leg.description: Leg identifier fixed at 112 for all sediment samples.

Site.description: Site identifier 680 for all sediment samples.

H.description: Uniform categorical label “A” assigned to all sediment samples.

Core.description: Core identifier assigning each sediment sample to one of nine distinct cores.

Type.description: Sediment sample type, consistently recorded as H for

Sect.description: Sediment sample section identifier ranging from 1 to 7.

Sect_2.description: Continuous numeric variable ranging between 5 and 130.

Sect_3.description: Integer values spanning 6–131, representing a continuous measurement.

Ca.description: Calcium concentration in sediment, measured in milligrams per kilogram.

K.description: Potassium concentration (wt %) measured in sediment samples.

Mn.description: Probability score indicating manganese presence likelihood in each sediment sample.

Na.description: Sodium concentration in sediment, expressed as weight percent.

P.description: Continuous numeric variable ranging from about 0.8 to 10.7 across samples.

Mo.description: Molybdenum concentration (ppm) in each sediment sample.

U.description: Measured value is a continuous numeric variable ranging from 3.37 to 29.28.

N.description: Probability score ranging from 0 to 1 for each sediment sample.

S.description: Sulfur content in sediment, expressed as weight percent.

TOC.description: Total organic carbon content of sediment, expressed as weight percent.

TC.description: Measured concentration values ranging from 0.39 to 14.63 in sediment samples.

Fe/Al.description: Ratio of iron to aluminum concentrations in each sediment sample.

Mo xs.description: Molybdenum concentration measured by X‑ray fluorescence.

U xs.description: U xs provides continuous numeric values measured across sediment samples.

EF.description: Continuous measurement of sediment property with values between approximately

Feac.description: Probability score between 0 and 1 for each sediment sample.

Femag.description: Probability score ranging from 0.02 to 0.16 for each sediment sample.

Fe Py.description: Probability of iron occurring as pyrite in each sediment sample.

Fe react.description: Continuous iron reactivity values measured for each sediment sample.

Ratio.description: Probability score ranging from 0 to 1 for each sediment sample.

Ratio_2.description: Probability score ranging from 0.03 to 0.5 for each sediment sample.

δ15N.description: Nitrogen isotopic composition expressed in per mil (‰).

Longitude.description: Geographic longitude of each sediment sample in decimal degrees.

Elevation.description: Elevation of sampling site, measured in meters relative to sea level.
